title: N52: Kurtosis collapse is VOL-OF-VOL dependent, not gamma-dependent
description: Key experiment: VT kurtosis reduction across 20 stocks + SPY. SPY 75.7% reduction vs individual stock avg 26.3% (t=-5.36, p<0.0001). 6/20 stocks show INCREASED kurtosis under VT. Best predictor: vol-of-vol (r=0.709). Gamma is irrelevant (r=0.133). Mechanism: VT compresses kurtosis by trimming rare extreme events. If high-vol episodes are rare but severe (high vol-of-vol, like SPY with correlation asymmetry), VT is very effective. If high-vol is sustained (low vol-of-vol, like NVDA), VT constant
